subject: Mathematics Methods
text: Consider the function f ( x ) = a x + b , where a and b are constants. The graph of y = f ( x ) has an asymptote with equation x = 1 and passes through the point ( 3 , − 1 ) . (a) Determine the value of a and the value of b . (3 marks) (b) State the equation of the other asymptote of the graph of y = f ( x ) . (1 mark) (c) Sketch the graph of y = f ( x ) on the axes below. (3 marks)
html:
Consider the function f(x)=ax+b , where a and b are constants. The graph of y=f(x) has an asymptote with equation x=1 and passes through the point (3,−1).

(a) Determine the value of a and the value of b. (3 marks)

(b) State the equation of the other asymptote of the graph of y=f(x). (1 mark)

(c) Sketch the graph of y=f(x) on the axes below. (3 marks)
